description: This source file is the main implementation of the BORIS behavioral observation software, written in Python using PySide6 for the GUI, and includes classes for the main application window, table models, and numerous methods for media handling, visualization, project management, and user interaction.

classes.name: TableModel
classes.description: A custom QAbstractTableModel for displaying event data in a table view within the application.

classes.name: MainWindow
classes.description: The primary application window class, inheriting from QMainWindow and Ui_MainWindow, managing the GUI, data, media playback, visualization, and user interactions.

methods.name: __init__(self, data, header: list, time_format: str, observation_type: str, parent=None)
methods.description: Constructor for the MainWindow class, initializing the UI, setting up various configuration parameters, and establishing connections.

methods.name: block_dockwidgets(self)
methods.description: Enables or disables the ability to move and float dock widgets to prevent strange behavior, especially on MacOS.

methods.name: advanced_event_filtering(self)
methods.description: Invokes advanced filtering for coded events.

methods.name: twEthogram_sorted
methods.description: Sorts the ethogram widget based on a column index and order.

methods.name: sort_twSubjects
methods.description: Sorts the subjects widget based on a column index and order.

methods.name: check_project_integrity(self)
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the current project, optionally testing media file accessibility.

methods.name: project_changed
methods.description: Marks the project as changed and updates the window title.

methods.name: remove_media_files_path
methods.description: Removes media file paths from the project file after user confirmation.

methods.name: remove_data_files_path
methods.description: Removes data files path from the project after user confirmation.

methods.name: set_media_files_path_relative_to_project_dir
methods.description: Sets media file paths relative to the project directory after user confirmation.

methods.name: set_data_files_path_relative_to_project_dir
methods.description: Sets data file paths relative to the project directory after user confirmation.

methods.name: view_behavior
methods.description: Displays detailed information and modifiers of the selected behavior.

methods.name: click_signal_from_coding_pad(self, behaviorCode)
methods.description: Handles click signals from the coding pad, simulating key press events.

methods.name: close_signal_from_coding_pad(self, geometry, preferences)
methods.description: Saves coding pad geometry and preferences upon closure.

methods.name: click_signal_from_subjects_pad(self, subject)
methods.description: Handles click signals from the subjects pad.

methods.name: signal_from_subjects_pad
methods.description: Receives signals from subjects pad and processes them.

methods.name: close_signal_from_subjects_pad(self, geom)
methods.description: Saves subjects pad geometry after it is closed.

methods.name: show_subjects_pad
methods.description: Displays the subjects pad window, with checks for project data and mode.

methods.name: show_all_behaviors
methods.description: Displays all behaviors in the ethogram widget.

methods.name: show_all_subjects
methods.description: Displays all subjects.

methods.name: tuple[bool,list] filter_behaviors( self, title: str = "Select the behaviors to show in the ethogram table", text: str = "Behaviors to show in ethogram list", table: str = cfg.ETHOGRAM, behavior_type: list = cfg.STATE_EVENT_TYPES, )
methods.description: Opens a dialog for filtering behaviors in the ethogram or time filtering.

methods.name: filter_subjects(self)
methods.description: Opens a dialog for selecting subjects to display.

methods.name: generate_wav_file_from_media(self)
methods.description: Extracts WAV audio from media files loaded in the media player.

methods.name: show_plot_widget
methods.description: Displays visualization widgets such as spectrogram, waveform, or event plots.

methods.name: update_realtime_plot
methods.description: Updates the real-time event plot if visible.

methods.name: plot_timer_out
methods.description: Timer callback to update visualizations like spectrogram, waveform, and event plots based on current media position.

methods.name: show_data_files
methods.description: Displays plots of data files, if any.

methods.name: hide_data_files(self)
methods.description: Hides plots of data files.

methods.name: modifiers_coding_map_creator
methods.description: Creates and shows the modifiers coding map creator window.

methods.name: behaviors_coding_map_creator_signal_addtoproject(self, behav_coding_map)
methods.description: Adds the behaviors coding map received from the creator to the current project.

methods.name: actionCheckUpdate_activated(self, flagMsgOnlyIfNew=False)
methods.description: Checks for software updates from the BORIS website and handles the update process.

methods.name: seek_mediaplayer
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the media player, error codes indicate success or failure.

methods.name: None jump_to(self)
methods.description: Prompts user for a specific time to jump to in media playback.

methods.name: previous_media_file
methods.description: Navigates to the previous media file in the playlist.

methods.name: next_media_file
methods.description: Navigates to the next media file in the playlist.

methods.name: set_volume
methods.description: Sets the volume of a specified media player.

methods.name: set_mute
methods.description: Toggles mute for the specified media player.

methods.name: automatic_backup(self)
methods.description: Performs an automatic backup of the project periodically.

methods.name: update_subject
methods.description: Updates current subject and the UI label.

methods.name: getCurrentMediaByFrame(self, player: str, requiredFrame: int, fps: float)
methods.description: Returns current media and frame index based on a required frame number.

methods.name: extract_frame(self, dw)
methods.description: Extracts and displays a frame from video or image at the current index, handling EXIF data for images.

methods.name: resize_dw
methods.description: Resizes dock widgets, especially overlays, based on the specified dock widget ID, adjusting overlay opacity and position.

methods.name: player_clicked
methods.description: Handles signals from media players when clicked or zoom/pan commands are issued, managing zoom and pan via coordinate calculations.

methods.name: configure_tvevents_columns(self)
methods.description: Configures visible columns of the events table, currently not implemented.

methods.name: populate_tv_events
methods.description: Populates the table view with event data, including filtering by subjects and behaviors, and handling event states.

methods.name: load_tw_events
methods.description: Loads events into the table view, applying filters for behaviors and subjects, and updating start/stop states.

methods.name: close_tool_windows(self)
methods.description: Closes all open auxiliary tool windows, such as spectrogram, measurements, coding pad, and others, clearing associated references.

methods.name: set_recent_projects_menu
methods.description: Populates the recent projects submenu with existing project files.

methods.name: edit_project_activated(self)
methods.description: Enables editing of the current project with GUI dialog, loading project details, and handling changes or backups.

methods.name: display_statusbar_info(self, obs_id: str)
methods.description: Displays information about the selected observation in the status bar, including time offset and interval.

methods.name: extract_observed_behaviors(self, selected_observations, selectedSubjects)
methods.description: Extracts unique behavior codes observed within selected observations and subjects.

methods.name: plot_events_triggered
methods.description: Triggers plotting of events in a time diagram, handling multiple observation selection, coding verification, and filtering.

methods.name: behaviors_bar_plot(self, mode: str = "list")
methods.description: Creates a time budget bar plot for behaviors across selected observations, with filtering and file saving options.

methods.name: load_project
methods.description: Loads a project dictionary into the main interface, updating behaviors, subjects, and interface state.

methods.name: open_project_activated
methods.description: Handles user activation to open a project, including integrity checks, version conversions, and loading project data.

methods.name: import_project_from_observer_template(self)
methods.description: Imports project data from Noldus Observer files (.otx, .otb, .odx), handling errors and integrating imported data.

methods.name: clear_interface(self, flag_new: bool = True)
methods.description: Resets main window UI components, preparing for a new or blank project.

methods.name: close_project(self)
methods.description: Closes the current project, offering to save or discard changes and resetting interface state.

methods.name: not_editable_column_color
methods.description: Provides a color for columns with not editable cells, based on the window background color.

methods.name: edit_project(self, mode: str)
methods.description: Allows creation, editing, or copying of a project, including GUI dialog and data population, with warnings about previous observations.

methods.name: save_project_json
methods.description: Saves the current project to a JSON file, handling different formats (.boris, .gz) with exception handling and versioning.

methods.name: save_project_as_activated
methods.description: Prompts user to specify a new filename for saving the current project, with extension management and overwrite confirmation.
